source_title: Pick of the stats: Norwich City v Watford - BBC
source_excerpt:
Norwich and Watford will seek to pull away from the Championship drop-zone when they meet at Carrow Road on Saturday (12:30 GMT).
The Canaries ended a six-game losing streak in all competitions with a 3-1 win at Charlton last time out but have lost their past three at home to sit 20th, one place and one point ahead of the Hornets.
Saturday's 1-0 defeat at Wolves meant Watford have taken one point from their six away league games, losing the past five in a row and scoring only once in that run, however they do have a fine recent record against Norwich.
Norwich City have won just four of their past 14 league games against Watford (L10), losing both meetings with the Hornets in the Championship last season.
